_about: Public-domain Jean-Baptiste Saint-Jure (1588-1657, Jesuit) in English for the Word Hoard: A Treatise on the Knowledge and Love of Our Lord Jesus Christ, vol. II (New York, 1870), The Spiritual Man (London, 1878) and The Religious (2 vols, New York, 1881-1883), translated by Sisters of Mercy, and Union with Our Lord Jesus Christ (Sadlier, entered 1876), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

saint-jure-the-religious-1: The Religious: a Treatise on the Vows and Virtues of the Religious State, vol. I, by a Sister of Mercy (New York: P. O'Shea; entered 1881)
saint-jure-the-religious-2: The Religious: a Treatise on the Vows and Virtues of the Religious State, vol. II, by a Sister of Mercy (New York: P. O'Shea, 1883)
